mapper.sql: select id, user_id, real_name, nick_name, birth_date, gender, school_name, grade, special_note, create_time, update_time from baby_info
mapper.select: where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time desc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into baby_info ( id, user_id, real_name, nick_name, birth_date, gender, school_name, grade, special_note, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{realName}, #{nickName}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{schoolName}, #{grade}, #{specialNote}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update baby_info set real_name = #{realName}, nick_name = #{nickName}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, school_name = #{schoolName}, grade = #{grade}, special_note = #{specialNote}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
